description.en: A wide editorial news and magazine template with light/dark themes, EN/RU localization, RSS link, footer navigation and social sharing icons.
description.ru: Широкоформатный редакционный шаблон для новостей и журнала: светлая/тёмная тема, EN/RU, RSS-ссылка, footer-навигация и социальные иконки.

integrationNotes: Logo image should replace brand.logoFallback when user uploads a logo.
Workspace site icon must stay separate from website logo and favicon.
RSS is enabled because this template is for publishing/news. Do not enable RSS by default for Portfolio, Landing, Business or Agency templates.
Colored visual blocks are temporary image slots and should become user images when media insertion is ready.
Template demo images are for preview only and should be replaced by the user's own images before publishing.

avoid: images where one person becomes the brand of the template
peopleRule.reason: Official templates must stay universal. Demo images may show work and atmosphere, but should not make a specific person the face of the template.

imageGuidelines.people: Allowed only as context, not as portrait.

message.en: Demo images are placeholders. Replace them with your own images before publishing.
message.ru: Демо-изображения — это заглушки для просмотра шаблона. Перед публикацией замените их своими изображениями.
